newsitem.title: GERMANY: Linde shares fall as H1 pre-tax up 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Linde shares fall as H1 pre-tax up 8 pct.

text.p: Shares in German diversified engineering group Linde AG fell on Tuesday after the group reported an eight percent increase in first half pre-tax profits to 262.1 million marks, below analysts' forecasts.
Shares fell 16 marks to 915 marks soon after the figures were issued, before recovering to trade at 926.20 marks, down 4.80 marks or over half a percentage point in later pre-bourse trade.
The overall IBIS DAX index was down 0.07 percent at 2,552.69 points at 0738 GMT.
Analysts' forecasts for Linde's first half profit ranged from 270 million marks to more than 300 million, or an increase of 11 to 20 percent.
